display_name: 联合恢复与条件扩散的同源波形诊断
description: 比较两条固定源训练模型与同一冻结 DURA 在合法源 pilot 的波形误差；无 F 或目标读取，不影响既定七景测试。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 deterministic FP32 TF32 off, two CPU threads, batch 8

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source paired IQ diagnostic only; no F or target and no identity-accuracy claim

checkpoint.initialization: Load fixed joint and conditional-diffusion source final20 and original frozen DURA; no training
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source metadata and checkpoint require legal matching 32768 fit IDs, no F/TX/V/target reads, frozen DURA; pilot excluded from both candidate fits
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Matching source-only contracts; two final checkpoints frozen without target selection; DURA may have seen pilot
checkpoint.selection_rule: Both final20 checkpoints were fixed in their own preregistered runs before target scoring; analyze both, no candidate selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2: at least 8192 MiB free, fewer than 3 total GPU apps and no other this-task GPU worker; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json with source per-view IQ NMSE and per-record better/worse counts; no trained model

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; source paired IQ geometry only

rows.method: Fixed DURA, frozen joint proposal and frozen conditional residual diffusion; shared received IQ and DURA physical context
rows.purpose: Determine whether source error has useful projected direction; no deployment or selection
rows.seed_notes: Two fixed models use model seeds 2026110812 (joint) and 2026110817 (diffusion); no new training, support or stochastic target choices.
rows.budget_ref: 672 source IQ pairs in 14 cells, batch 8; same-record DURA and two frozen candidate outputs; two-record real-checkpoint smoke

notes: Both 32768-record source fits exclude the 672 pilot IDs; DURA may have seen source pilot and pilot has been explored before.
Three fixed model outputs use identical source observations and DURA contexts; no model updates, target data, F weights or outputs or TX labels.
Two-record real-checkpoint GPU smoke precedes source-only diagnostic; does not change the two already running formal evaluations.
Source waveform NMSE and per-record gains cannot substitute for Tri-SIG-TIME SSL seven-view identity scores.
